messages:
sam-support: FYI — scheduled kernel/runtime maintenance in EU tonight 00:00–02:00 UTC. Rolling window across runtime-eu clusters. Expect short, infrequent 503s; target is <30s per cluster. We need statuspage + email to impacted customers. @alex.eng can you confirm rollback/pinning plan?

deploy-bot: automated note: maintenance window 2001234567 registered. Targets: runtime-eu-1, runtime-eu-2, runtime-eu-canary. Canary deploy scheduled 00:05 UTC.

alex.eng: Plan: we will soft-pin Dedicated customers to model-runtime v1.4.2 for the window unless they opt out. Rollback target is v1.4.1. Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% sustained for 3m or latency p95 > 2s for 5m. I will prepare a tiny runbook with the exact CLI steps.

tara-support: Draft statuspage copy below — please sanity-check and approve (short):

"Status Update: Scheduled Maintenance — EU runtime"
"We will perform planned maintenance on our EU inference runtime on 00:00–02:00 UTC. During the maintenance window some requests may temporarily return 503 errors or experience brief latency increases. We expect service restoration within seconds for affected clusters. If you subscribe to Dedicated capacity and have a pinned runtime, your traffic will remain pinned during the window unless you opt into the rolling upgrade. No action required unless you receive a follow-up from Support."

Email subject suggestion: "Planned maintenance for EU runtime — possible brief interruptions"
Email body snippet: "Hi — heads-up that we have a scheduled maintenance window for EU inference (00:00–02:00 UTC). You may see short, intermittent 503s. If you prefer we hold your runtime on the previous binary for the window, reply to this email and we'll pin you. We'll send a post-maintenance note once complete. — Redwood Inference Support"

olivia-cs: I'll pull the list of Dedicated accounts in EU and mark ones that requested no-upgrade. DMing sam-support with the list.

sam-support: OK — I'll publish the statuspage 15 minutes before the window and send the email 30 minutes prior. Publishing checklist: include affected clusters, expected impact, contact for escalation, and link to runbook. @mike-ops pls be on watch. :eyes:

mike-ops: On it. Monitoring plan: watch canary errors and rollout metrics. If deploy-bot reports >0.5% errors for 3m on canary, we'll hold the rollout and escalate. Rollback command ready.

alex.eng: Quick rollback/playbook (short):
1) Pause rollout: `/deploybot pause 2001234567`
2) Freeze pin for Dedicated: `/infra pin runtime-eu-1 --version v1.4.1 --scope dedicated`
3) Rollback service: `/deploybot rollback runtime-eu-1 --to v1.4.1`
4) Route traffic to fallback pool if needed: `/infra route fallback-eu`
5) Notify customers and post-update on statuspage.

Link to runbook: https://go/runbooks/kernel-maintain-eu (full steps + contacts).

tara-support: Approved. I'll post the statuspage draft and queue the email template. Will tag this thread when live. :white_check_mark:

sam-support: Thanks all — will update here after publish and once maintenance completes.

[reaction summary: sam-support :thumbsup:, alex.eng :rocket:, deploy-bot :gear: ]
